_note: document-access-exception (Ruben 24 Oct, board DqDocumentenBeheer, the Who can see this card). A document may name the only people and groups who see it, with a reason. The case's handler and administrators keep access (InformatieobjectAccessGuard + DocumentAccessExceptionRule). Written only through PUT/DELETE /api/informatieobjecten/{id}/access-exception, which also restricts the file in OpenRegister and appends to accessExceptionHistory. Minor bump: two optional properties, nothing existing changes. Raw OpenRegister access (review 25 Oct): the schema's own authorization admits dossiq-medewerkers only to documents without an exception (restricted false or absent) and everyone else through the derived accessUsers/accessGroups (SharePrincipalDeriver pattern), on read; update and delete of a restricted document are for its cases' handlers (accessHandlers) only, not for a listed outsider, so lists, totals and facets agree with dossiq's own rule. The exception fields and the derived lists are written only by dossiq-background-service (property authorization); DocumentAccessExceptionWriter saves them as that account after its own checks.

accessException.title: Access exception
accessException.description: Only these people and groups see this document, besides the case's handler and administrators. A reason is required. Set and removed through the document's Who can see this card.

accessExceptionHistory.title: Access exception history
accessExceptionHistory.description: Every set, change and removal of the access exception: who, when, the old and the new exception, and the reason.

old.description: The exception before, absent when there was none.

new.description: The exception after, absent when it was removed.

restricted.title: Restricted
restricted.description: DERIVED from accessException by the writer; true while the document names its only readers. The read rule admits dossiq-medewerkers only where this is false or absent. Written only by the background service account.

accessUsers.title: Readers (people)
accessUsers.description: DERIVED: the people of the access exception plus the handlers of the document's cases, as bare uids, so the read rule can say accessUsers $contains $userId. Recomputed when an exception is set and when a case's handler changes.

accessGroups.title: Readers (groups)
accessGroups.description: DERIVED: the groups of the access exception, as bare group ids, so the read rule can say accessGroups $contains $user.groups.

accessHandlers.title: Handlers
accessHandlers.description: DERIVED: the handlers (assignee) of the document's cases, as bare uids. Only they, besides staff on an unrestricted document, may update or delete the record through OpenRegister.
